extractor: read directly from the official IRCC pages listed in source_roles
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from. source_excerpt is verbatim government wording, lowercased by the normalizer. Nothing here is paraphrased into a requirement, and nothing is included that the page did not state.
not_extracted: IMM 5484 document checklist contents — the registered 'documents' URL is a PDF download wrapper and states no requirements in its HTML. The checklist itself is a PDF and was not parsed.

Marine crew documents (seaman's book, ship/port agent invitation, recruiter introduction letter, employment contract). These appear on the apply page under a purpose-specific branch; the normalizer flattens the page's tabs, so attributing them to the general visitor route would be wrong.
Business visitor qualification criteria — same branch-flattening hazard.
Visa-office-specific additional documents. The page states 'your visa office may require additional documents' but the list is per-country and behind a selector.
Processing times — not stated on any page read.

The list of countries and territories whose citizens must give biometrics. IRCC gates it behind a separate checker tool. Until it is extracted, the biometrics step and fee are shown unconditionally with the condition stated in their description.

requirements.label: Be in good health
requirements.description: IRCC lists this under the lead-in "you must:" on the eligibility page. The lead-in is not part of this quote because it does not sit adjacent to this bullet on the page.

requirements.label: Have no criminal or immigration-related convictions
requirements.description: IRCC also lists separate grounds of inadmissibility, including criminal activity, human rights violations, organized crime, and security, health or financial reasons. Listed under the same "you must:" lead-in as the other basic requirements.

requirements.label: Have enough money for your stay
requirements.description: IRCC does not publish a fixed threshold: the amount depends on the length of the stay and on whether you stay in a hotel or with friends or relatives.
requirements.source_excerpt: have enough money for your stay the amount of money you will need depends on how long you will stay and if you will stay in a hotel, or with friends or relatives.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: have enough money for your stay The amount of money you will need depends on how long you will stay and if you will stay in a hotel, or with friends or relatives.

requirements.label: Digital copy of your valid passport or travel document
requirements.description: A clear, colour copy of the passport you will travel on, including the page showing your birth date and country of origin, and any pages with stamps, visas or markings. IRCC states the document should be valid for at least 6 months from your planned travel date.
requirements.source_excerpt: all applicants need to include a digital copy of your valid (not expired) passport or travel document your passport or travel document should be valid for at least 6 months from the date you plan to travel.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: All applicants need to include a digital copy of your valid (not expired) passport or travel document Your passport or travel document should be valid for at least 6 months from the date you plan to travel.

requirements.label: Letter of invitation from someone in Canada
requirements.description: IRCC states a visitor may also need a letter of invitation. Where you are visiting family, IRCC also asks for proof of your relationship to the person inviting you — a marriage certificate, a statutory declaration of common-law union (IMM 5409), a birth certificate, or an official document naming you as a parent.

requirements.label: Biometrics fee
requirements.description: CAD 85.00 per individual. IRCC states a family maximum applies to a family of 2 or more eligible people. Payable only if you must give biometrics, which depends on your citizenship — see the biometrics step above.

requirements.label: Evidence of previous travel
requirements.description: IRCC lists this under a heading it labels "recommended documents", not as a requirement. Copies of previous passports or visas used in the last 10 years, entry and exit stamps, and study or work permits showing time spent outside your country.
requirements.source_excerpt: recommended documents travel history if you’ve travelled to canada or to other countries, this can show that you’ve been able to get a visa in the past.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Recommended documents Travel history If you’ve travelled to Canada or to other countries, this can show that you’ve been able to get a visa in the past.

requirements.label: Bank account statement (proof of funds)
requirements.description: IRCC lists this under a heading it labels "recommended documents", not as a requirement. It shows you have enough money to support yourself during your stay.

extraction_note: Nine excerpts in this file were repaired on 2026-08-21 after scripts/verify-excerpts.ts was written. They had been assembled rather than quoted: block joins were punctuated into sentences, the accessibility text '(opens in a new tab)' was silently dropped, and one fee excerpt used a literal '...' to elide the interleaved "what's this?" expander. Every claim was correct; none of those quotes were verbatim. The claims are unchanged - only the evidence now matches the page.
